description: This file is a CMake module for locating and configuring the gstreamer-video-1.0 library within a build system. It defines logic to check for the presence of the library, sets relevant variables for include directories and libraries, and defines an imported target for use in CMake projects.

methods.description: Checks for the specified package configuration module, here 'gstreamer-video-1.0'.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes another CMake script, 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs', which provides standardized argument handling for package detection.

methods.name: FIND_PACKAGE_HANDLE_STANDARD_ARGS
methods.description: Standard CMake macro to handle package detection results.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced in CMake GUIs to hide them by default.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates a library file, here for 'gstvideo-1.0'.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets variable values for use in the build system based on detection results.

methods.name: add_library
